From the cellar & the kitchen

Cellar Notes

Short pours from the notebook

Nov 4, 2026

The 2010 Barolos are waking up

Two bottles opened this week suggest the vintage has finally turned the corner — the tannins have softened into something silky, and the rose-petal aromatics are all there. If you are holding them, the next five years look generous.

Oct 28, 2026

A white Burgundy for roast chicken night

A village-level Mâcon with a year of bottle age did everything a weeknight wine should: bright, mineral, and gone by the second helping. Proof that the best pairing is often the simplest one.

Oct 21, 2026

Decanting: thirty minutes is the sweet spot

We poured the same young Rioja at five intervals. At thirty minutes the fruit had opened without the edges dulling — an hour flattened it. Set a timer; your future self will thank you.

Recipe of the Week

Crispy-skin salmon with lemon & herbs

The secret is a cold pan, a dry fillet, and patience — press gently for the first minute and do not touch it again until the skin releases on its own.

Servings Serves 4

    Sear skin-side down 7 minutes, flip for 30 seconds, rest 3. Finish with lemon, olive oil, and torn herbs. Full method in the story below.
